strings.GROOVE_MERC_QUOTE: <style=GrooveQuote>Merc is a certified Hopoo Games banger who already plays really well in vanilla. I dislike how easy it is for Merc to spam skills into crowds - the Expose tweak is intended to address that. Focused Assault has also recieved a light rework to be a little weaker into crowds. To compensate, both of Merc's utilities got their cooldowns reduced!</style>
